system.description:
Date (Healing) (Action): Expend one Healing Date from a RIS and choose one target within 5ft (you can choose yourself). Remove one level of Battle Fatigue from that target. A target may benefit from a Healing Date no more than once per quick rest.

Date (Healing), p.206 (Action): Until the start of your next turn, ignore 2 levels of Exhaustion from the Dying Condition. You may stack the effects of Healing Dates. (The book prints both texts.)

1 Item Slot (Small, Quickdraw) · 5gc · First Aid, rulebook p.203
